criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Every frame stands in a world, sky and Gulf haze on the exteriors and a TXT.interior room on 6. Four or five frames lean on a default. Frame 4 is a noise-textured plane with a blue outline, the hull a few pixels and a pale foot band with moire. Frame 7's buildings are untextured boxes and its channel a near-black slab. Frame 9 is frame 5 with the hull taken out and a dead middle third. Frame 5's dek sits on the lit deckhouse. Frame 6's avatars show mesh tears and an empty dais with no visible window. Frame 3's hull is a flat barge slab and its range label ends past the safe line. Flat noon light everywhere and no reflection under the hulls on 1 and 3. Frame 2 is the best craft and frame 8 holds up, 20 figures and 7 vests counted.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One world, one palette, one accent for plan figures, one hero through its states, two visible devices, the 05/09 pair a real filmstrip device. The value track holds with one declared dip at 6. The two aerials read as diagram-on-terrain.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every slide numeral traces, seven of twenty matches the render, derived figures are labelled, and the fact check's refusals are honoured. The spine rests on the Tribune where a court order exists. Frame 3 hangs the Marauder's figures off a hull in the Brownsville channel. The first comment omits c4.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: Who, what, where and when are named, and the close carries the condition and the schools objection. No deadline, meeting or next action. Frames 2 and 3 spend two frames on company marketing while c31, c33 and c36 go unused.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: The cover earns the swipe, frame 2 does not pay it, the break is not paid until frame 6. The 5 then 9 rhyme lands.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Clean and attributed, but wire copy, with Saronic says and drawn to illustrate on nearly every frame. Oseguera's line (c33) is not used.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: A new subject, palette and hour. The one carried object through nine states is the house formula, and 10-04 was also noon.

one_sentence_fix: Spend frames 2 and 3 on the June hearing itself with c31 and c33, and rebuild frames 4 and 7 with water that carries the sky and the hull at readable size.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A noise-textured plane with a blue outline, the hull a few pixels, an aliased foot band
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Drop the camera to about 250 m oblique over the channel edge with riprap and reflective water in the near third and the hull at least 120 px long

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Untextured box buildings, a near-black channel, the hull a speck
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Give the channel frame 1's water and moor the hull at the near build position at about 15 percent of the width

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Frame 5 with the hull deleted leaves a dead middle third
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Leave the empty keel blocks standing along the line with their contact shadows

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The dek sits on the lit deckhouse and the block line can't be read
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Pan right and pull back so the sheer sits below the dek with daylight under the keel

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Avatar mesh tears, an empty dais, no window
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Put a lit window behind the dais with three commissioners seated, and push the near heads out of frame

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A flat barge slab with no reflection, the range label past the safe margin
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Model sheer and flare, add a dark planar reflection, and end the label at x 1000 css

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: No reflection or shadow under the hull, flat noon light, a blurred foreground strip
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Add the hull's reflection and wash, lower the sun to about 35 degrees, bring riprap into the lower-left corner
